note: PF-10: under a broken locale (LC_ALL and LANG naming a locale the system lacks) no helper call through the launcher prints a locale warning on stderr. Before the fix perl printed `perl: warning: Setting locale failed.` and four more lines before main.pl ran, for every subcommand but `hook` (whose stderr the launcher sends to /dev/null), so a skill's Bash output carried them. The launcher's Perl route now sets PERL_BADLANG=0. Only that warning is in scope: where /bin/sh is bash (Debian-like images, fedora), bash itself prints `/bin/sh: warning: setlocale: LC_ALL: cannot change locale (...)` when it starts under such a locale, before the launcher's first line runs, so no plugin code can stop it. stderr may therefore hold those shell lines and nothing else: no perl warning, no other line
